newsitem.title: USA: Foundation Health eyes Physicians Health bid.
newsitem.headline: Foundation Health eyes Physicians Health bid.

text.p: Foundation Health Systems Inc. said Tuesday it is negotiating the possible acquisition of Physicians Health Services Inc.

Foundation Health, a managed health care services provider based in Los Angeles, said terms of the deal are still being negotiated but both companies agreed that the final price should not be more than $30 per share.
Physicians Health's stock rose $3.50 to $26.375 on Nasdaq at in afternoon trading. Foundation Health fell 37.5 cents to $27.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
A number of outstanding issues still needed to be resolved and there could be no assurances discussions would result in a takeover, Foundation Health said.
There would be no further announcements until a pact was reached or talks were terminated, it added.
Physicians Health, based in Shelton, Conn., is the parent of three health maintenance organisations in Connecticut, New York and New Jersey.
